'''''Endor''''' was a [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruiser]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]. It was destroyed sometime in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] when it was led into a trap near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[RZ7-6113-23]].

==History==
[[File:Ambush_at_RZ7-6113-23.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Ambush at RZ7-6113-23|destruction]] of the ''Endor''.]]

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the ''Endor'' was on a patrol near the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]] when it intercepted two [[TIE/sr starfighter]]s. The ship tried to follow the starfighters only to be led into a [[Ambush at RZ7-6113-23|trap]]. The [[Unidentified captain (Endor)|captain]] realized the trap too late and the ''Endor'' was destroyed by a single blast from a fully charged surface-to-space cannon from the [[Restored Empire]] [[RZ7-6113-23 base|base]].

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lar Ndigo]] was later charged by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Battle of RZ7-6113-23|investigate]] the disappearance of the ''Endor''.
